question: Which of the following dynasties’ genealogy was found in the Bijolia inscription?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chahamana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Bijolia inscription provides the genealogy of the **Chahamana** dynasty.
 
• Bijolia is an important historical site known for its inscriptions which provide valuable information about medieval Indian dynasties.
